lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: xià yí wèi qǐng zuò
lines.en: Next, please sit down.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: nǐ hǎo wǒ jīn tiān yǒu yù yuē
lines.en: Hello, I have an appointment today.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ nǐ de hù zhào
lines.en: Please give me your passport.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo de zài zhè lǐ
lines.en: Sure, here it is.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ shì nǎ guó rén
lines.en: What's your nationality?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǒ shì fà guó rén
lines.en: I'm French.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me lái tái wān
lines.en: Why did you come to Taiwan?
lines.fr: Qu'est-ce qui vous amène à Taïwan ?

lines.speaker: player
lines.zh: 我在台灣工作，也學中文。
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài tái wān gōng zuò yě xué zhōng wén
lines.en: I work in Taiwan, and I also study Chinese.
lines.fr: Je travaille à Taïwan, et j'apprends aussi le chinois.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ lái tái wān duō jiǔ le
lines.en: How long have you been in Taiwan?
lines.fr: Depuis combien de temps êtes-vous à Taïwan ?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: yǐ jīng yì nián le
lines.en: One year already.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ dǎ suàn zhù duō jiǔ
lines.en: How long do you plan to stay?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài zhù liǎng nián
lines.en: I'd like to stay two more years.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ gōng zuò
lines.en: Where do you work?

lines.speaker: player
lines.zh: 我在一家台北的公司上班。
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài yì jiā tái běi de gōng sī shàng bān
lines.en: I work at a company in Taipei.
lines.fr: Je travaille dans une entreprise à Taipei.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ zuò shén me gōng zuò
lines.en: What do you do?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǒ shì gōng chéng shī
lines.en: I'm an engineer.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.zh: 你的老闆知道你今天來這裡嗎？
lines.pinyin: nǐ de lǎo bǎn zhī dào nǐ jīn tiān lái zhè lǐ ma
lines.en: Does your boss know you're here today?
lines.fr: Votre patron sait que vous êtes ici aujourd'hui ?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: zhī dào wǒ jīn tiān shàng wǔ qǐng jià
lines.en: Yes, I took this morning off.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zhù zài nǎ lǐ
lines.en: Where do you live now?

lines.speaker: player
lines.zh: 我住在大安區的一間公寓。
lines.pinyin: wǒ zhù zài dà ān qū de yì jiān gōng yù
lines.en: I live in an apartment in Da'an District.
lines.fr: J'habite un appartement dans le quartier de Da'an.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: qǐng xiě xià nǐ de dì zhǐ
lines.en: Please write down your address.
lines.fr: Écrivez votre adresse, s'il vous plaît.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo wǒ xiě zhōng wén hái shì yīng wén
lines.en: OK, should I write it in Chinese or in English?
lines.fr: D'accord, je l'écris en chinois ou en anglais ?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: xiě zhōng wén xiě qīng chǔ yì diǎn
lines.en: In Chinese. Write a bit more clearly.
lines.fr: En chinois. Écrivez un peu plus lisiblement.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: méi wèn tí wǒ màn màn xiě
lines.en: No problem, I'll write slowly.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ huì shuō zhōng wén ma
lines.en: Can you speak Chinese?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: huì yì diǎn wǒ měi tiān dōu xué
lines.en: A little, I study every day.
lines.fr: Un peu, j'étudie tous les jours.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ xué zhōng wén
lines.en: Where do you study Chinese?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǒ wǎn shàng zài dà xué shàng kè
lines.en: I take evening classes at a university.
lines.fr: Je suis des cours du soir à l'université.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ shuō de bú cuò jì xù jiā yóu
lines.en: You speak well. Keep it up.
lines.fr: Vous parlez bien. Continuez comme ça.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: xiè xie wǒ huì jì xù nǔ lì
lines.en: Thank you, I'll keep working hard.
lines.fr: Merci, je vais continuer mes efforts.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ de zī liào dōu dài lái le ma
lines.en: Did you bring all your documents?
lines.fr: Vous avez apporté tous vos documents ?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: dài lái le zhè shì wǒ de zhèng jiàn
lines.en: Yes, here are my ID documents.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: hái yào yì zhāng gōng zuò zhèng míng
lines.en: I also need proof of employment.
lines.fr: Il faut aussi une attestation de travail.

lines.speaker: player
lines.zh: 公司給了我一份，在這裡。
lines.pinyin: gōng sī gěi le wǒ yí fèn zài zhè lǐ
lines.en: My company gave me one, here it is.
lines.fr: Mon entreprise m'en a donné une, la voici.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: zhè fèn yǐng běn bù qīng chǔ
lines.en: This copy isn't clear.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: duì bù qǐ wǒ zài yǐng yìn yí fèn
lines.en: Sorry, I'll make another copy.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: qǐng xiān tián zhè zhāng biǎo gé
lines.en: Please fill in this form first.
lines.fr: Remplissez d'abord ce formulaire, s'il vous plaît.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: zhè lǐ yào xiě shén me
lines.en: What should I write here?
lines.fr: Qu'est-ce que je dois écrire ici ?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: xiě nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ
lines.en: Write your phone number.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo hái xū yào zhào piàn ma
lines.en: OK. Do you also need a photo?
lines.fr: D'accord. Il faut aussi une photo ?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.zh: 要兩張，最後在這裡簽名。
lines.pinyin: yào liǎng zhāng zuì hòu zài zhè lǐ qiān míng
lines.en: Two of them. Finally, sign here.
lines.fr: Il en faut deux. Pour finir, signez ici.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo de wǒ qiān hǎo le
lines.en: OK, I've signed.
